title: Show HN: We measure AI model governance across 22 axes and publish signed receipts
body:
We built a public measurement board that scores AI models on 22 behavioral axes (governance, safety, provenance, jailbreak resistance, etc.) and publishes the results as signed, independently verifiable receipts.

Every measurement is:
- Content-addressed (SHA-256)
- Ed25519-signed
- Anchored on Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Sigstore (Rekor)
- Verifiable by anyone without contacting us

We also measure:
- 425 stablecoins across 211 chains ($310.8B total)
- 16 XRPL instruments
- 26 SWIFT banking subjects
- 3,400+ MCP servers
- 36 AI models across all 22 axes

Free root, free cards, free verify. Paid proofs via x402 (USDC micropayment, no accounts).

Try it: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
RLUSD cross-chain dashboard: https://councilof.ai/interop/stablecoin-attestation-2026-09/

We're not selling seats or subscriptions. We're selling receipts — evidence that survives scrutiny by regulators, auditors, courts, and counterparties, without needing us to exist tomorrow.

Measurement, not certification.
